description: Several critical systems do not forward complete security logs.

description: Encryption controls vary across databases holding synthetic customer data.

description: Retention schedules are not technically enforced in several repositories.

title: Critical-vendor assessments are incomplete
description: Security assessments are missing or stale for multiple critical vendors.

description: Business and technology security responsibilities are not consistently documented.
